lead: Hulk Hogan was an American professional wrestler, born on 11 August 1953 in Augusta.
He died on 24 July 2025 in Clearwater at the age of 71.
He has 28 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Florida Sports Hall of Fame and WWE Hall of Fame.
Below you will find a verified overview of Hulk Hogan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Hulk Hogan was born on 11 August 1953 in Augusta, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Terry Eugene Bollea at birth and is publicly known as Hulk Hogan.
His listed education includes University of South Florida, Thomas Richard Robinson High School and Hillsborough Community College.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists professional wrestler as his main occupation, including work with Total Nonstop Action Wrestling, WWE and World Championship Wrestling.
He performs on bass guitar, guitar and voice.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Filmography and Screen Credits
paras: Public databases list 28 screen credits for Hulk Hogan, spanning 1982 to 2013. That breaks down as 26 as cast member, 1 as performer and 1 as producer.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Linda Hogan (married 1983, until 2007) and Sky Daily (married 2023, until 2025).
He is a parent to Brooke Hogan and Nick Hogan.
He is associated with Clearwater as a place of residence.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Height, Weight and Physical Stats
paras: Hulk Hogan stands 193 cm tall, which converts to roughly 6′ 4″ and 1.93 m.
His recorded body weight is 125 kg (about 276 lb). Body measurements change over time, so treat this as the figure on public record rather than a current reading.

sections.heading: Hulk Hogan — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Hulk Hogan circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a professional wrestler, employment with Total Nonstop Action Wrestling, WWE and World Championship Wrestling, brand partnerships and sponsored social content.
If a verified figure is published by a credible outlet — a company filing, an election affidavit, or an official disclosure — this section will be updated with the source attached.
